+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
+ import { router } from 'expo-router';
+ import DateTimePicker from '@react-native-community/datetimepicker';
+ import { NotificationService } from './services/notifications';
+ import { NotificationSchedule } from './services/notification-schedules';
+ import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
+ 
+ export default function ScheduleScreen() {
+   const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState<NotificationSchedule[]>([]);
+   const [showTimePicker, setShowTimePicker] = useState(false);
+   const [editingSchedule, setEditingSchedule] = useState<NotificationSchedule | null>(null);
+   const [selectedTime, setSelectedTime] = useState(new Date());
+ 
+   useEffect(() => {
+     // Load initial schedules
+     setSchedules(FEEDING_REMINDERS);
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const handleTimeChange = (event: any, selectedDate?: Date) => {
+     setShowTimePicker(false);
+     if (selectedDate) {
+       setSelectedTime(selectedDate);
+       if (editingSchedule) {
+         const updatedSchedule = {
+           ...editingSchedule,
+           time: `${selectedDate.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${selectedDate.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`,
+         };
+         updateSchedule(updatedSchedule);
+       }
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const updateSchedule = async (schedule: NotificationSchedule) => {
+     const updatedSchedules = schedules.map(s => 
+       s.id === schedule.id ? schedule : s
+     );
+     setSchedules(updatedSchedules);
+     setEditingSchedule(null);
+     
+     // Update notification in the service
+     const notificationService = NotificationService.getInstance();
+     await notificationService.scheduleNotification(schedule);
+   };
+ 
+   const deleteSchedule = async (id: string) => {
+     const updatedSchedules = schedules.filter(s => s.id !== id);
+     setSchedules(updatedSchedules);
+     
+     // Cancel and reschedule all notifications
+     const notificationService = NotificationService.getInstance();
+     await notificationService.cancelAllScheduledNotifications();
+     for (const schedule of updatedSchedules) {
+       await notificationService.scheduleNotification(schedule);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const sendTestNotification = async (schedule: NotificationSchedule) => {
+     const notificationService = NotificationService.getInstance();
+     await notificationService.scheduleNotification({
+       ...schedule,
+       id: `${schedule.id}-test`,
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
+       <View style={styles.header}>
+         <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()} style={styles.backButton}>
+           <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color="#000" />
+         </TouchableOpacity>
+         <Text style={styles.title}>Notification Schedule</Text>
+       </View>
+ 
+       {schedules.map((schedule) => (
+         <View key={schedule.id} style={styles.scheduleItem}>
+           <View style={styles.scheduleInfo}>
+             <Text style={styles.scheduleTime}>{schedule.time}</Text>
+             <Text style={styles.scheduleTitle}>{schedule.title}</Text>
+             <Text style={styles.scheduleBody}>{schedule.body}</Text>
+           </View>
+           <View style={styles.scheduleActions}>
+             <TouchableOpacity
+               onPress={() => {
+                 setEditingSchedule(schedule);
+                 setShowTimePicker(true);
+               }}
+               style={styles.actionButton}
+             >
+               <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={24} color="#007AFF" />
+             </TouchableOpacity>
+             <TouchableOpacity
+               onPress={() => sendTestNotification(schedule)}
+               style={styles.actionButton}
+             >
+               <Ionicons name="notifications-outline" size={24} color="#007AFF" />
+             </TouchableOpacity>
+             <TouchableOpacity
+               onPress={() => deleteSchedule(schedule.id)}
+               style={styles.actionButton}
+             >
+               <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={24} color="#FF3B30" />
+             </TouchableOpacity>
+           </View>
+         </View>
+       ))}
+ 
+       {showTimePicker && (

+           value={selectedTime}
+           mode="time"
+           is24Hour={true}
+           display="default"
+           onChange={handleTimeChange}
+         />
+       )}
+     </ScrollView>
+   );
+ }
